plan.notes: Transcribed from the official SCC 'Programming Certificate' program map, Catalog 2026-27, published June 08, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/7638/PublishedPdf). Certificate of Achievement (grade of C or better in each course). Official Total Units: 22-23; this seed models the first-listed/recommended path at the low end = 7+4+4+4+3 = 22 units (BUS 310 at 3 units). Semester sums verified against the map's 7-8 / 4 / 4 / 4 / 3 headers. Choice slots: (1) ME BUS 310 (3-4, modeled at 3) / ENGL C1000 / ENGL 488 Honors — Business Communications; BUS 310 prerequisite: BUS 100, ENGL C1000, or ESLW 340 with a grade of C or better (documented, not encoded); students not placing directly in ENGL C1000 take the ENGL 80/ENGL C1000 combo; (2) ME CISP 400 / CISP 401 — Object Oriented Programming with C++ (4). Sequencing prereqs per map: CISP 360 requires CISP 301; CISP 400 & 401 require CISP 360; CISP 430 requires CISP 400 or 401; CISP 457 requires CISA 323 and CISC 310 (listed in external_prereqs) and any one of CISP 360, CISP 400, or CISP 401. CISP 430 is typically only offered during the spring semester; CISP 457 is typically only offered during the fall semester. tccns mirrors SCC local course codes (California community colleges do not use TCCNS).
